verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents only generic trace ingestion: its own SDK, direct calls from your code or tool calls, or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle. The evidence never names a prebuilt integration for LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, or any other framework. A generic OTel endpoint is a developer building block rather than an existing framework integration, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: Use SDK trace ingestion or an OpenTelemetry exporter pointed at Chronicle.
Send them from your own code, from your agent's tool calls, or from an OpenTelemetry exporter, then query them in Timeline or through the SDK.
